title: Settlement Offers and After-Hold Hardship Options in Hardship and Protective Holds
content:
Each tier of **Hardship and Protective Holds** settles two questions about settlements while the hold runs, and two about what the hold opens once it is over: whether the account then qualifies for a Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan or a Hardship Settlement, and for how long those remain available.

## Tier settings

| Tier | Settlement may be offered while the hold runs | Acceptance of a settlement ends the hold that day | Ended hold qualifies for a Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan | Hold qualifies for a Hardship Settlement | After-hold window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30-Day Hardship Pause | Yes | Yes | No | No | 0 |
| Documented Hardship Hold | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | 60 |
| Disaster Relief Hold | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 90 |
| Financial Assistance Review Hold | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | 60 |
| Long-Term Hardship Hold | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 120 |
| Military Service Hold | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 90 |

## Settings explained

- **Settlement may be offered while the hold runs** — whether a settlement may be offered on the account while the hold runs.
- **Acceptance ends the hold** — whether the consumer's acceptance of a settlement on the account ends the hold that day.
- **Qualifies for a Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan** — whether the ended hold qualifies the account for a Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan.
- **Qualifies for a Hardship Settlement** — whether the hold qualifies the account for a Hardship Settlement.
- **After-hold window** — the calendar days after the hold ends during which the hardship plan or settlement remains available.

## Points of reading

- The Financial Assistance Review Hold is the only tier on which no settlement may be offered while the hold runs.
- In every tier, a settlement the consumer accepts on the held account ends the hold that day.
- The 30-Day Hardship Pause opens neither hardship option and has an after-hold window of 0 days; the Documented Hardship Hold opens the Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan only.
- The Long-Term Hardship Hold carries the longest after-hold window, 120 calendar days.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A Documented Hardship Hold ends on 10 April. Its window of 60 calendar days counted after the hold ends runs from 11 April through 9 June, during which the account qualifies for a Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan; the tier does not qualify the account for a Hardship Settlement.
